subject: Post-demo: AaronTech comparative test plan & unanswered probes
body:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@aarontech.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: rachel.li@aarontech.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up / next steps

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood yesterday — the demo clarified a lot. High level takeaways from our side:
- We liked Redwood's lower p95 latency and the prefix caching idea; could be big for our chat product.
- Pricing model looks competitive but we need clear numbers for a sustained 3M token/month workload.
- We're running a head-to-head bakeoff between Redwood and VendorX next week.

Couple of open questions we wanted captured in a short test plan:
1) How does Redwood handle mixed short+long context sessions — we'd like to see latency and cost numbers for the same workload used in yesterday's demo.
2) Any recommended quantization profile that keeps quality above our BLEU-like scoring threshold (we'll share the test set).
3) Can you confirm network egress patterns for the Private deployment option — we need to vet with infra/security.

We'll confirm the testing window by Monday. Recording attached.

Best,
Alex
Head of Product, AaronTech

-----Original Message-----
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@aarontech.com>
Cc: rachel.li@aarontech.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap: AaronTech discovery + suggested test plan

Alex / Rachel —

Thanks for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all stay aligned.

Summary of pain & goals (what you told us)
- Pain: Current provider has unpredictable latency spikes under mixed traffic; cost rises sharply when long-context sessions are mixed with short queries.
- Goal: Stable p95 latency < 350ms for chat flows and 25-30% reduction in per-token cost vs current vendor at target volume.
- Compliance: AaronTech needs Private deployment with KMS + audited network egress controls.

Proposed bakeoff scope (initial):
- Baseline: Reproduce three representative flows (short single-turn, long multi-turn with KV cache, mixed burst) using AaronTech test corpus.
- Metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec throughput, unit cost estimation (raw + estimated infra), model quality (AaronTech BLEU-like metric).
- Vendors: Redwood hosted + Redwood Private (quantized profile) vs VendorX hosted (their recommended config).
- Duration: 3 days of steady-state runs + 1 day of spike/burst tests.

Immediate asks from us (what we will deliver)
- AaronTech to share test corpus + quality thresholds and a brief infra contact for Private network questions.
- Agree on a 3-day window next week (we tentatively propose Tue–Thu).

Next steps / owners
- Jasmine (me): finalize test matrix and share a single-sheet checklist by EOD Friday.
- Aditya Rao: will prepare an initial quantization + config recommendation and run a small sanity smoke test.
- Marissa Cole: will prepare commercial outline based on projected steady-state tokens.

Attachments: call recording (call-recording-20260115.mp3).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the single-sheet matrix shortly.

Jasmine Liu
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

---- Reply ----
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: AaronTech bakeoff — action items and matrix draft

Team —

Adding internal owners and draft of the tests we need to run. Please review and flag anything missing.

Draft test matrix (high level):
- Test A: Short-turn chat (seq len 32) — 1M queries over 24h; metric: p95 latency, token cost.
- Test B: Long-turn chat (seq len 2k, KV cache used) — 100k sessions; metric: p95 latency, cache hit ratio, quality.
- Test C: Mixed bursts (random mix) — 3rd day spike tests; metric: tail latency under burst, graceful degradation.
- Quality test: run AaronTech corpus against both vendors and report delta in BLEU-style score.

Aditya: can you validate the quantize+runtime config we should try for the Private deployment (suggest two profiles: HQ and CostOpt)?
Marissa: can you run a quick cost-sensitivity calc for 3M tokens/month using the projected metrics once we have the run numbers?
Camila: I'll need you to take lead on coordinating VendorX test env and collecting their run artifacts.

I attached a draft sheet (aarontech-bakeoff-matrix.xlsx) — please update by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Jasmine

---- Reply (internal) ----
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 11:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AaronTech bakeoff — action items and matrix draft

Jasmine / team —

Quick notes from infra/eng perspective:
- I'll spin up two Private configs:
  * HQ: FP16-ish (lower quant) running on A100-equivalent; prioritize quality at slightly higher cost.
  * CostOpt: int8/4 quant profile tuned for latency; we should expect ~20–30% lower memory and cost but might see small quality delta.
- For mixed context sessions we need to ensure KV cache warmup is captured — propose 10% warmup period in the runs.
- I'll capture network egress fingerprinting and supply a one-page summary for AaronTech's infra/security.

Open question for sales/commercial: do we want to expose both HQ and CostOpt in the initial bakeoff or only CostOpt + hosted?

Aditya
Principal SW Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

---- Final internal summary (to be sent to AaronTech Monday) ----
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@aarontech.com>, Rachel Li <rachel.li@aarontech.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: AaronTech bakeoff plan & logistics (final) 

Alex / Rachel —

Per our internal alignment, attached is the final bakeoff checklist and schedule. Quick highlights:
- Tests: Short / Long (KV) / Mixed burst. We will run HQ + CostOpt on Private and Redwood hosted baseline; VendorX will run their recommended config.
- Schedule: Tue 20 Jan — Wed 22 Jan; on-call windows and run owners listed on sheet.
- Security: Aditya attached a short network egress summary and KMS notes; we will provide audit logs within the Private deployment during the test window.
- Commercial: Marissa will follow up with a preliminary 12-month price projection by EOD Wed once we have run metrics.

Immediate asks for AaronTech:
1) Share the test corpus (s3 link or Drive) and the quality scoring script.
2) Confirm an infra contact for firewall/egress checks (name + email).
3) Approve the Tue 20 start window.

Attachments: aarontech-bakeoff-matrix.xlsx, call-recording-20260115.mp3

We’ll standby and be ready to start once we have the corpus and infra contact.

Thanks — looking forward to the runs.

Jasmine Liu
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
